title: Cops Find Hidden Camera in Airbnb Bathroom
description:
A family's vacation turned into a nightmare in a Hocking Hills, Ohio, rental cabin when they discovered a hidden camera in a downstairs bathroom. The property owner, Jason Yard, 39, was identified as the suspect after investigators discovered his extensive history of purchasing Wi-Fi spy cameras and related equipment. He claimed the camera was for security purposes, yet placed the device directly above a toilet. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
